question: How many people in India use UPI daily?
idealClarificationQuestions: Daily Active Users (transacted at least once today) vs daily logged-in users? Assume DAU = transacted at least once.
Counting P2P + P2M + bill payments + UPI Lite + AutoPay mandates? Yes, all UPI rails included.
Average weekday or specific spike day (salary day, festival)? Assume average weekday.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down. Start from internet/smartphone users → bank account holders → registered UPI users → segment by usage frequency to derive daily actives.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Registered UPI users (transact at least monthly): ~420M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Adults with both smartphone + bank account
Registered UPI users (transact at least monthly)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: Heavy daily users (multiple txns/day) ~35% = 147M; Medium (3-4 txns/week) ~30% = 126M, of which ~40% transact on a given day = 50M; Light (1-2 txns/week) ~25% = 105M, of which ~20% on a given day = 21M; Occasional ~10% = 42M, of which ~5% = 2M.

calculationFlow: Adults with both smartphone + bank account: ~600M.

Segment by usage frequency: Heavy daily users (multiple txns/day) ~35% = 147M; Medium (3-4 txns/week) ~30% = 126M, of which ~40% transact on a given day = 50M; Light (1-2 txns/week) ~25% = 105M, of which ~20% on a given day = 21M; Occasional ~10% = 42M, of which ~5% = 2M.
